summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 remains compatibility-only and cannot auto-become current authority; v2 assigns typed roles, with normative, authority, and implementation inputs authorized; selection and content hashes are distinct; adapter controls transport, paging, continuation, coverage, and truncation; ready receipts require immutable hashed generations plus atomically advanced validated pointers; consumers resolve pointers only; execution, publication, and semantic-review gates are independent; Knowledge self-change derives from changed-set/path policy; attempts require leases and heartbeats; retention protects current, lifecycle, authorization, terminal references, and active attempts; committed-evidence deletion needs maintainer approval and cleanup receipt; all consumers must migrate before 2026-08-18 can create a new current receipt; historical current directories remain immutable pending retention; ADR extends 0048, 0050, 0057, 0058, 0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices; does not grant lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap
